biggest_catch: No fixed rate is published — translators set their own per-word rate, so there is no minimum earnings floor and no guaranteed tasks; you compete for jobs against thousands of vetted translators, and steady work goes only to those who pass the quality bar.
catches: No official fixed pay rate exists — you set your own per-word rate, so earnings depend entirely on the rate you set, your language pair, and whether clients pick you.
Zero guaranteed tasks: jobs are assigned per project; Translated states 'Hundreds of interesting jobs assigned per hour' but not to you specifically.
Qualification evaluation is required before you can take paid work; only approved professionals get access.
Work is variable gig work, not fixed income — effective hourly pay can be low on cheap language pairs or difficult content.
Translated charges clients ~$0.10/word on average (per their public pricing page); translators keep only a fraction of what clients pay — the platform margin is not disclosed.
Payment is once per month (end of month), so there is a cash-flow lag between completing work and being paid.

c3.evidence: No participation fee — registration is free ('Registration takes 10 mins. We need your personal details, experience & skills, and languages & rates.'); you pay nothing to join or be listed.

c4.evidence: Official page states the payment cadence: 'Get paid end of the month, as fast as an employee.'

eligibility: Professional translators (including new young talent per the official page) who pass Translated's evaluation. You register with personal details, experience and skills, languages, and your own self-set rates; remote from anywhere. No degree requirement is stated on the official page.

steps: Go to https://www.translated.com/top and start registration (about 10 minutes).
Enter personal details, experience and skills, languages, and your own per-word rates — you decide your rate.
Read and accept the Privacy Policy and Conditions linked on the signup form.
Receive project assignments matched to your languages and specialization.
Deliver translations to spec and on deadline.
Get paid once per month, at the end of the month.
